name: @open-autonomy/platform
description: Open Autonomy's public platform: the backend with patronage on top — money in from GitHub Sponsors, Polar and grant credits, the explore page, the patrons wall — deployed as one Cloudflare Worker.

scripts.dev: bun run build && pnpm exec wrangler dev
scripts.deploy: bun run build && pnpm exec wrangler deploy --var DEPLOY_COMMIT:$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)
